lead.headline: Pickens is still on waivers and the window closes at 01:00
lead.deck: The tight end and the defence are done, the first by way of two moves in three hours. Tuten is still on the bench. One claim is left, and this is the last edition before it processes.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Saquon Barkley did not practise on Wednesday and every report has him unlikely for London; Philadelphia signed Dameon Pierce to cover. Alvin Kamara, on your bench, was listed out with a sore back. Bhayshul Tuten, 3.1 above Ollie Gordon by projection, is still on the bench, for the third edition running. And the tight-end seat changed hands twice today: Darren Waller for Brenton Strange at 09:52, as this morning's edition recommended, then Strange for Colston Loveland at 13:06. They project the same 9.7. The slot is filled, which is what mattered, and the churn rule now closes it for a week. The Jaguars replaced the Ravens at 12:40. Together those moves took you from 101.9 to 114.6 as set and from 39% to 46% against Kings of the North. The news tonight is George Pickens. KEI returns dropped him for Romeo Doubs in the small hours, he is still on waivers until 01:00 on Thursday, and Dallas's final injury report for Thursday night does not list him. Nothing reported explains the drop. He is Dallas's second receiver with 28 targets in four games, and ESPN has him 42 points ahead of Josh Downs over the season. Put in the claim with Downs as the drop. You are 7th of ten, so it will probably fail and cost nothing; if it wins it costs three places in an order that never resets, and I think he is worth that. If it lands, he plays at 18:15 on Thursday: put him in the flex before then. Whatever happens with the claim, start Tuten.
